title: ParticipantIntakeProfileViewDocument
description: Server-maintained guest-owned read view of the two portable intake values the form profile review shows: the intake revision that claimParticipantFormProfile fences a LinkedIn save on, and the saved LinkedIn URL. Written by a trigger on participantIntakeProfiles/{uid}; a guest without an intake profile has no view, which reads as revision 0 and no LinkedIn URL, as getParticipantFormProfile returned it. Never the other intake values or their sources.
x-owner: Participant form profile view projector (profiles form profile view triggers)
